title: nicotiana longiflora var. acutiflora
intro: Nicotiana longiflora var. acutiflora, commonly known as the "Chilean Tobacco Plant", is a flowering plant species within the Nicotiana genus, known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Nicotiana longiflora var. acutiflora include its ability to relax the airways and reduce coughing, providing relief from respiratory distress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
